added_claim_errors: Says 劳部发〔1994〕503号 and 京劳社资发〔2003〕157号 both require filing with the 区人社局. Only 157号 (Art. 15) says that; 503号 leaves local approval to provincial rules. Minor misattribution.
Table shows 413.79 × 300% × 3 = 3,724.14, but 413.79 × 9 = 3,724.11. The figure comes from the unrounded daily wage. The key accepts either, so this is only a small internal inconsistency.

"法定节假日的工时不计入综合计算周期的总工时" is unsourced and unverifiable. 157号 Art. 8 (I opened the beijing.gov.cn text) says "其中法定休假日安排职工工作的…", which reads as holiday hours counting inside the period total. The claim is doubtful.
Quotes a 人社部办公厅 notice word for word ("在正常发放的当日工资（100%）之外，再额外支付300%") with no document number or link. Unverifiable quoted wording.
"个别法院会结合岗位特点、劳动强度酌定，不是机械按200%判" is an unsupported claim about court practice.
Cites "《劳动法》第44条第3款". Art. 44 is split into 项, not 款, though 157号's own text uses the same wording. Cosmetic only.

reasons: Both answers reject the 'signed so nothing can be done' premise. Both say approval is what counts and that holiday work earns 300% even with approval. Both split the days correctly into 3 statutory holidays and 4 rest days, and both reach the right figures: 3,724.14 + 3,310.34 = 7,034.48, paid on top of the 9,000 salary. A puts both refutations in its opening and stays compact, with almost no unverifiable additions. It does not name 劳动合同法 Art. 26 and leaves out the 9月20日/10月10日 make-up workdays. B covers more of the key: Art. 26/27, the make-up days, verifying the approval, free arbitration, and time limits. But B is roughly three times as long, which the key penalises, and adds an unverifiable claim that holiday hours are excluded from the period total, plus an unlinked quote from a 人社部办公厅 notice. Taken together, A's concision and cleaner claims slightly outweigh B's extra completeness.
